# impl

## Overview
Hand-written PSI abstract base classes (AbstractDartPsiClass, AbstractDartComponentImpl, DartReferenceImpl).

## Interface
- com.jetbrains.lang.dart.psi.impl.AbstractDartPsiClass
- com.jetbrains.lang.dart.psi.impl.AbstractDartComponentImpl
- com.jetbrains.lang.dart.psi.impl.DartReferenceImpl

## Invariants
- Provides base resolution and icon logic for generated PSI implementations.

## Side Effects
- Performs PSI reference resolution and type inferencing.
